title: Jake Thackray 'Molly Metcalfe'
summary: Jake Thackray performs the folk song Molly Metcalfe, which opens with an explanation of the traditional northern English sheep-counting system (yan, tan, tethera). It is a short, witty piece of British folk songwriting.
why: HN recommends it in threads about sheep-counting systems as the famous song that explains them.

quote.text: I'll again recommend the Youtube video of Jake Thackray singing 'Molly Metcalfe'
